scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "uv run uvicorn accountable.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm -w frontend run build && uv run --env-file .env uvicorn accountable.main:app --port 8000
scripts.test: concurrently -m 1 --success all -n backend,frontend,e2e "npm run test:backend" "npm run test:frontend" "npm run test:e2e"
scripts.format: npm -w frontend run format && uv run ruff check --select I --fix && uv run ruff format
scripts.check:static: concurrently -m 1 --success all -n prettier,eslint,tsc,ruff-format,ruff,ty,gitleaks "npm -w frontend run format:check" "npm -w frontend run lint" "npm -w frontend run typecheck" "uv run ruff format --check" "uv run ruff check" "uv run ty check" "npm run check:secrets"
scripts.check: concurrently -m 1 --success all -n static,test "npm run check:static" "npm test"
scripts.check:quick: concurrently -m 1 --success all -n static,backend,frontend "npm run check:static" "npm run test:backend" "npm run test:frontend"
